notes.title: Teeny Tiny Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37785172/3ede6478c0fbbdc474f5b9113ae022424a68881c.png[/img]

it's a tiny update:

notes.title: Random Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37785172/6ca8dfff0b4588eab435de1cde1d6568c9218891.png[/img]

As part of our daily routine we rolled the dice and looked at our chart to decide what new things to add to this game now.

We rolled our wheel of fortune exactly four time and this is what it landed on:

[list]
[*]A tiny new secret area.
[*]A couple of new Onigiris.
[*]New localizations, this time it's traditional and simplified Chinese, Korean and Spanish.
[*]Some bug fixes that have been inside the game since launch, but nobody really noticed or thought they where just "part of the Glitch".
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37785172/c4094a41c8c726b2253452efb8b38ba9b17833c8.gif[/img]

This update might confuse some users due to it's random nature, but trust us, it's all going to make sense it the end. Or is it?
Or maybe we are running out of quirky patch note ideas and started to just write down the random stream of consciousness we call our mind. Who knows? Stop asking so many questions and stop confuzzling everyone! Do you see Cable Boy up there? He's confuzzled, too.

notes.title: 10 Things we have updated on Super Cable Boy (You won't believe Nr. 1)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37785172/700d8f9c5239d7456580785f6d1fef0220059310.gif[/img]

Well, well, well. A lot has happened since the last update and Cable Boy has been electrocuting his circuits for you day in day out. But don't worry.  We're here to comfort you and tell you all about it. He has become smarter, more stable, but most of all, a boy of culture.

[b]LOCALIZATIONS[/b]
I know, I know... It's kind of ironic that the event news itself is only available in English, but hey, we gotta cut budget somewhere, you know?
Anyways...
Cable Boy downloaded himself some language lessons and is now fluent in:
[list]
[*]Japanese
[*]German
[/list]
He's still learning a few other languages, though. Almost there. Learning new vocabulary is difficult if you have only 32kb of Memory.
[list]
[*]Korean
[*]Traditional Chinese
[*]Simplified Chinese
[*]Thai
[*]Spanish
[/list]
Will be ready next month!

[b]OST RELEASE[/b]
Did you know Cable Boy loves to dance? If you've ever pressed [R2] during the game, you probably did.
Make sure to check out the OST, which includes all of Cable Boys favorite tunes (Which is basically every track from the whole game)! You can find it linked on the main store page or right [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1496630/Super_Cable_Boy_Soundtrack/]here[/url]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
And as always we fixed a couple of bugs and glitches here and there (not the good ones, though. The good ones stay.):
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the player to be teleported outside the disassembler boss fight room, when taken damage and playing with extra lifes
[*]Reworked the level highlighting logic on the world map
[*]Beep boop
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37785172/dd6fdb15c4cbedfc8ab3fb705bc27347d2c48cdc.gif[/img]

[b]STEAM SUMMER SALE[/b]
Not sure if you've noticed, but yeah! The game is 20% off durign Steam Summer Sale! If you haven't already, go grab it! Also, why are you reading the announcement of a game you don't even own? Appreciate it, though.


[b]There's one more thing...[/b]


[b]NINTENDO SWITCH RELEASES[/b]
aaaaaand.... the game is now available on Nintendo Switch! That's it. That's all I'm going to say about this one. This is not a promotion for the Switch Version, just a footnote containing purely non promotional information. Don't buy it. Just know that it's there. (I didn't write this because Steams policies are holding me hostage at all. Please don't sue me. Buy the game though. Just on Steam, of course. What? Who wrote all that? no one. You just imagined it.)

notes.title: Speedhack Update 0.9b
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37785172/0b1c3507c4b0ba5c4b850a7feaa4e57c8c4fbe8a.png[/img]

[b]WARNING: Installing this Speed Hack may cause overclock issues on your Cable Boy device. Other wanted and unwanted behavior like "just going too fast" or "look, mom I'm super speedy" have been reported by current users. This speed hack is using an oversight by the developer which was found inside the Assembly code to install a speed hack on to your the Cable Boy device.[/b]

What this speed hack does:
[list]
[*]Breaks cable boys clock speed.
[*]Patches in a new area and additional achievements.
[*]Improves the accuracy of the in game clock.
[*]Adds an option to skip cutscenes so Cable Boy can go fully unthrottled.
[*]Fixes some bugs (e.g. issues with the blacklister).
[/list]

What this speed hack doesn't do:
[list]
[*]Break the 4th wall even further.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37785172/dbd1e31d7ea71226ed726360368592d62d064122.gif[/img]

notes.title: Jailbreak Update 0.72
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37785172/df5a4d4639ed42135fb78bd505656b8a44db4a7d.png[/img]

[b]WARNING: Installing this Jailbreak onto your Super Cable Boy device may cause software instability, frequent crashes or other unwanted behavior. This jailbreak is using an oversight by the developer which was found inside the cloud code to jailbreak the Cable Boy firmware. [/b]

What this Jailbreak does:
[list]
[*]Patches in a new secret area and additional achievements.
[*]Breaks Cable Boy's operating system.
[*]Hacks a bunch of new Onigiris and Achievements into the game.
[*]Injects some malicious features into the game, like deleting save slots.
[*]Breaks the game.
[/list]

What this Jailbreak doesn't do:
[list]
[*]Make the game easier.
[*]Make the game more stable.
[*]Make the game less glitchy.
[/list]
